rawContent: Unbelievable really. I'm a #metoo survivor, several of my friends are metoo survivors too. We all stayed silent for years and it was the wrong thing to do. Illegal NDA's created an environment of gagged silence. No one better dare challenge me on anything I posted on the issue.

Honestly not the day I wanted to be dealing with any of this but it seems I was dragged into it because I spoke out. Friends of mine were forced to lock their accounts because of the abuse they suffered. Not online abuse, daily life abuse, years of it. I won't stay silent. #metoo

@jypsie_soul @UntamedBeauti Harassment online I dealt with posting screenshots repeatedly for months. The real life, not online issue is being dealt with legally and it is a #MeToo matter that involves several other victims. I was not posting ANYTHING last night.

@ZionAngel20 Getty Images, same group of photographers used to gaslight me several times. This feels very targeted. Especially when I can connect back to the stalker from earlier this year. Red flags everywhere. Wasn't supporting #MeToo victims either. Just attacking them. @UntamedBeauti

I have a real life, not on social media #metoo issue that I have posted about. Several of my friends do too. This is not some online predator, someone's posting at me crap this is a life altering issue. I'm not going to have that tarnished by online attention seeking drama whore.

I would tell this person to quit posting libel but she's obviously mentally unstable. Author? Getty Photographer? Also targeted on her followers/following list other people in the same #metoo issue as I am in. Red flags? You bet. Not wasting more of my time with that insane woman

The really strange thing is what I called out "ipoet" for was stealing an image that belonged to a television show/camera man and claiming it for his own. Now this one claims to be from Getty? Strange isn't it. Rogue batshit crazy stalker Reva or connected to the #metoo issue?

Just stay away from me and I won't have to post the truth about you. You picked the wrong woman to mess with. I'm fearless now. #MeToo made me fearless and I am not backing down from anyone's libel, abuse, fake implied photos, lies, gaslighting, doxxing, or harassment ever again.

You are the one that needs to go to jail. Creating a fake account and posting my private info without my consent. Perhaps @torontopolice or @RCMPONT can assist. I do not consent to be abused by you nor will I be harassed by your libel. Leave me alone #metoo @PerezHilton @Twitter https://t.co/gBr4Sqc9x7

Since there was another person that is connected to my #metoo issue that person was trying to lure in/had lured in on that new fake account there are serious implications as to what is going on with that situation. Gain her trust and get her story to get at part of mine? Curious.

I am a #metoo survivor. I don't take lightly to personal information being posted by a fake account. I don't run around libelling or harassing. Should it become necessary I have a powerful legal firm at my disposal - I believe this woman is trying to fame seek through me. Ban her

She has obviously scoured my Tweets since I was inactive for so long. Neither of us are part of "a group", we have no connection to "ipoet" and this appears to be a deliberate attempt to discredit both of us in connection to my #metoo claims as she has contacted another survivor.

Serious #MeToo development and I am trying to find the right words for it. I do intend on posting. I just need to find the right words. I've spoken privately to a few people connected and they felt I need to do this. Strange timing with the other doxxing I received or connected?

So @SimonCowell paying for the person who ABUSED multiple women backstage during his shows to go to rehab. Does @robbiewilliams know that Roycey ABUSED multiple women both backstage & women he tried to lure into sex to "meet celebs"? @TheSun knows about the #MeToo run THAT story.

It's not only the #MeToo issue which several women are willing to step forward on and tell their stories. It's not the scam being run for sexual favours of "meeting celebs". It's now what is this GoFundMe for. Fraud? @SimonCowell @robbiewilliams @TheSun @danwooton @MirrorCeleb

This. As is stated on her account. This woman was promised she would meet Robbie, Simon, all of the judges last year by Roycey. She's posted her proof. I understand why she doesn't want her name on her account after the way Roycey harassed her. Let her tell her story #MeToo

Multiple victims not one asking for a penny just for justice. Roycey as bad as Savile. Investigate this. Anxiety, depression, PTSD, several of the victims have small children, children with disabilities, disabilities themselves. #MeToo @TheSun @MirrorCeleb @EntDailyUK

I will see this through to the bitter end. I never shared my story publicly. It's not the kind of thing to just casually drop online. It's life altering. Others have come to me too. If I can be a rock for them. I will. It costs nothing to help others. #MeToo
@time_to_out_you Thank you so much. That means a lot to me. We support each other. It's such a good feeling to know we are all not alone in this. #MeToo
